great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: There is no limit on room rent charges during hospitalization, so you can choose any room without extra deductions.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: Intensive Care Unit Charges (ICU Charges): The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'
great.explanation: ICU charges have no separate cap, so full ICU expenses are covered without restriction.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: The policy restores your base sum insured unlimited times per year, usable even for the same illness, giving you extra coverage after your limit is used.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis... (vi) In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: Your sum insured increases by 50% each claim-free year up to 100%, and this bonus continues even after you make claims, so your coverage grows over time.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: For any single Claim during a Policy Year, the maximum Claim amount payable shall be sum total of Sum Insured, Cumulative Bonus , Cumulative Bonus Super (if applicable), Plus Benefit (if applicable), Unlimited Care (if applicable).
great.explanation: The policy pays beyond the base sum insured using accrued bonuses and benefits, providing extra financial protection.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... for the Medical Expenses incurred towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.explanation: Home treatment is covered if it meets policy conditions, offering broader coverage beyond hospital stays.

great.name: Cashless Network
great.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person for Medical Expenses incurred towards Hospitalization through Cashless or Reimbursement Facility
great.explanation: You can avail cashless treatment at network hospitals or claim reimbursement for hospitalization expenses.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months, which is within the normal market range.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Waiting period for listed illnesses is 24 months, which is standard in the market.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except for accidents, which is a standard waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered for 60 days before hospital admission, which meets market standards.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for 180 days after discharge, which is at the higher end of standard coverage.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the amount as specified in Policy Schedule , for the Reasonable and Customary Charges necessarily incurred on availing Air Ambulance services
good.explanation: Air ambulance coverage is available as an optional benefit within specified limits.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Clause 4.2(1), page 37 and Annexure I (List I – Optional Items) pages 58-59
bad.explanation: Consumable items like gloves and masks are excluded by default, so you may have to pay out-of-pocket unless you buy an optional cover.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: For diseases or conditions or procedure that have a specified sub-limit then all related expenses shall be covered up to the sub-limit specified for that disease or condition or procedure.
bad.explanation: The policy allows sub-limits on specific diseases or procedures, which can reduce your effective coverage for those conditions.

bad.name: Domiciliary Exclusions
bad.quote: Any Medical Expenses incurred for the treatment in relation to any of the following diseases shall not be payable under this Benefit : 1. Asthma; ... 5. Diabetes Mellitus and Diabetes Insipidus; ... 7. Hypertension; ...
bad.explanation: Several common conditions like asthma, diabetes, and hypertension are excluded from domiciliary hospitalization coverage.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim...
bad.reference: General Conditions, Clause 4, page 14 and Optional Benefit 3.2.7, page 24-25
bad.explanation: The policy mentions a co-pay clause that applies if chosen, which is a negative feature as any co-pay clause is considered a red flag.
